title: First-run flow: small frictions a new deployment's first people meet
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第二组第三组也同意」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

## Items

| # | What a person meets | Where measured | Suggestion |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Nothing asks the company name. Every invitee reads 「王总 邀请你加入 Default Organization」 | `main` | Ask at first sign-in, or let the first admin rename it from the home page |
| 2 | Joining by invitation takes three screens: register, then 「接受邀请」, then 「邀请已接受 … 继续」 | Published 18.3.0 | Registering from an invitation link accepts it; end on the app |
| 3 | The time zone dialog opened right after an unrelated action, on top of the toast saying what to do next (the invitation link). The toast expired behind it | Published 18.3.0 production mode. Not reproduced under `os dev` on `main` | Ask at a calm moment, or do not cover a toast |
| 4 | After a sign-out, the next person lands on the previous person's page. A new member first sees 「你没有访问此应用的权限」 for the Setup page the admin had open | `main`: `/login?redirect=%2Fapps%2Fcom.objectstack.setup%2F…`. #29174 removed filter, search and sort from this redirect and kept the path | An explicit sign-out goes to home |
| 5 | The scaffold's sample `note` object stays in the project and is listed by `list_objects` over MCP. A developer building a repair app may never notice it | `main`: `templates/blank/src/objects/note.object.ts` | Say in the generated docs that it is a sample to delete, or have `os g object` offer to remove it |

## Left out on purpose

- Prefilling the email on the invitation form: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-preview.ts:34-38` records a ruling that refused the unmasked variant, so the seat does not suggest it.
- Admin-side honesty about email: the invitation toast already says no mail was sent. The password reset half is #30107.

Take these rows one by one. They do not depend on each other.
